ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OLD=ROOT.parent/'coordinate-yolo-selftrain-20261015'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
# Direct visual transcription from sources-1..5.png, not frame/time interpolation.
times=['08:49','08:52','08:56','08:59','09:23','09:27','09:31','09:37',
 '07:14','07:21','07:28','07:36','07:43','07:49','08:22','08:30',
 '04:00','04:21','04:45','05:45','06:07','06:29','06:51','07:14',
 '09:55','10:03','10:14','10:57','11:08','11:18','11:27','11:46',
 '12:09','12:31','12:40','12:50','13:30','13:38','13:46','13:55']
classes=list('0123456789-,+:');selected=read(ROOT/'selected-sources.json')
old=read(OLD/'pilot-v2/pilot-manifest.json');anchor=old['anchors']['744']
rows=[]
for source,clock in zip(selected,times):
    text=source['text'];x=38.;objects=[]
    for c in text:
        if c.isdigit():box=[x-2,3,x+24,39];advance=24.42
        elif c=='-':box=[x-2,21,x+15,29];advance=17.45
        elif c==',':box=[x-2,28,x+11,42];advance=13.09
        else:raise ValueError(c)
        objects.append({'char':c,'class':classes.index(c),'xyxy':[round(v,2) for v in box]});x+=advance
    date_start=x+31.;delta=date_start-318
    context='2026-10-14 14:'+clock+'+8'
    assert len(context.replace(' ',''))==20
    for c,box in zip(context.replace(' ',''),anchor['boxes'][12:]):
        a,t,b,d=box
        # Broad font-cell annotations allow a different second digit to use
        # the same slot previously occupied by a narrow 1.
        if c.isdigit():a,b=(a+b)/2-13,(a+b)/2+13
        objects.append({'char':c,'class':classes.index(c),'xyxy':[round(a+delta,2),t,round(b+delta,2),d]})
    rows.append({'id':source['id'],'frame':int(source['id'][-6:]),'kind':'annotated-text','sceneGroup':source['sceneGroup'],
      'image':source['nativeRaw'],'imageSHA256':source['nativeSHA256'],'sourceImage':source['sourceImage'],'sourceSHA256':source['sourceSHA256'],
      'text':text+' '+context,'objects':objects,'split':'train','annotation':'Known own XYZ + directly viewed clock, proposed font cells; requires per-image raw QA before training.'})
out=ROOT/'annotation-draft.json';assert not out.exists();out.write_text(json.dumps({'classes':classes,'rows':rows},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
for page in range(5):
    canvas=np.full((8*135,1784,3),230,np.uint8)
    for i,r in enumerate(rows[page*8:page*8+8]):
        image=cv2.resize(cv2.imread(r['image']),(1784,96))
        for obj in r['objects']:
            a,t,b,d=obj['xyxy'];cv2.rectangle(image,(round(2*a),round(2*t)),(round(2*b),round(2*d)),(0,255,0),1)
            cv2.putText(image,obj['char'],(round(2*a),11),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.35,(0,255,255),1)
        cv2.putText(canvas,r['id'][-6:]+' '+r['text'],(8,i*135+23),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.6,(0,0,0),1)
        canvas[i*135+30:i*135+126]=image
    cv2.imwrite(str(ROOT/f'boxes-{page+1}.png'),canvas)

assert len(positives)==67 and len({r['id'] for r in positives})==67

os.environ['YOLO_CONFIG_DIR']=str(OLD/'settings');os.environ['YOLO_AUTOINSTALL']='false'
sys.path.insert(0,str(OLD))
import torch,cv2,ultralytics
from ultralytics import YOLO
from coordinate_decode import decode
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def main():
    out=ROOT/'evaluation.json';assert not out.exists()
    weights=ROOT/'training/expanded-200e/weights/last.pt';classes=list('0123456789-,+:')
    items=json.loads((ROOT/'evaluation-inputs.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['inputs']
    torch.set_num_threads(4);model=YOLO(str(weights));assert list(model.names.values())==classes;rows=[]
    for item in items:
        path=Path(item['image']);assert sha(path)==item['imageSHA256'];image=cv2.imread(str(path));assert image.shape==(48,892,3)
        started=time.perf_counter()
        prediction=model.predict(source=image,imgsz=896,rect=True,conf=.25,iou=.45,max_det=256,device='cpu',verbose=False,save=False)[0]
        boxes=prediction.boxes.cpu();objects=[{'char':classes[int(c)],'class':int(c),'score':float(s),'xyxy':list(map(float,b))} for b,s,c in zip(boxes.xyxy.tolist(),boxes.conf.tolist(),boxes.cls.tolist())]
        rows.append({**item,'detections':objects,'decode':decode(objects),'milliseconds':(time.perf_counter()-started)*1000})
    report={'scope':'Own expanded detector, image-only CPU inference; includes fit frames scored separately.',
       'weights':str(weights),'weightsSHA256':sha(weights),'classes':classes,'torch':torch.__version__,'ultralytics':ultralytics.__version__,

    out.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2));print('Label-blind CPU inference',len(rows),flush=True)

"""Post-evaluation failure analysis only; does not change detector or decoder."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,statistics
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OLD=ROOT.parent/'coordinate-yolo-selftrain-20261015'
sys.path.insert(0,str(OLD));from coordinate_decode import iou
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
judgments={r['id']:r for r in read(ROOT/'report.json')['judgments']};rows=[]
for r in read(ROOT/'evaluation.json')['results']:
    j=judgments[r['id']]
    if j['trainedFitOnly'] or j['state']!='present' or j['outcome']!='miss' or r['decode']['reason']!='conflicting-character-boxes':continue
    objects=sorted(r['detections'],key=lambda x:(x['xyxy'][0]+x['xyxy'][2])/2)
    threshold=max(12,.75*statistics.median(o['xyxy'][2]-o['xyxy'][0] for o in objects if o['char'].isdigit()))
    groups=[]
    for o in objects:
        if not groups or o['xyxy'][0]-groups[-1][-1]['xyxy'][2]>threshold:groups.append([])
        groups[-1].append(o)
    group_rows=[]
    for g in groups:
        conflicts=[{'characters':[a['char'],b['char']],'centerX':round((a['xyxy'][0]+a['xyxy'][2]+b['xyxy'][0]+b['xyxy'][2])/4,2)} for i,a in enumerate(g) for b in g[i+1:] if a['char']!=b['char'] and iou(a['xyxy'],b['xyxy'])>.45]
        group_rows.append({'observedCharactersIncludingConflicts':''.join(o['char'] for o in g),'commas':sum(o['char']==',' for o in g),'conflicts':conflicts})
    comma_groups=[g for g in group_rows if g['commas']==2]
    context_only=len(comma_groups)==1 and not comma_groups[0]['conflicts'] and any(g['conflicts'] for g in group_rows if g is not comma_groups[0])
    rows.append({'id':r['id'],'contextOnlyByObservedGrouping':context_only,'groups':group_rows})
